plan.title: 坂田銀時 (Sakata Gintoki)
plan.summary: A high-mobility, counter-heavy melee fighter who balances 'lazy' defensive stances with explosive, comedic bursts of speed. He excels at punishing aggressive enemies with parries and 'lazy' strikes that deal unexpected damage.

slots.name: 木刀的重量 (Weight of the Wooden Sword)
slots.purpose: Provides a 'Lazy Stance' that rewards timing. While not moving, Gintoki gains a small shield. If hit while in this stance, he performs a 'reflexive parry' dealing minor damage back to the attacker and resetting his next Q's cooldown.

slots.name: 隨意揮砍 (Careless Swing)
slots.purpose: A standard horizontal slash. If cast while the 'Lazy Stance' shield is active, it becomes a 'Counter-Slash', increasing range and damage significantly.

slots.name: 靈魂的奔跑 (Soul's Sprint)
slots.purpose: A quick dash forward. If it hits an enemy, Gintoki performs a 'Comedic Trip', stumbling into them and applying a 'Slow' effect while dealing minor damage.

slots.name: 反擊：木刀防禦 (Counter: Wooden Defense)
slots.purpose: Gintoki enters a focused defensive state for 1.5 seconds. Any projectile or melee attack hitting him during this window is deflected, and he immediately performs a 'Point-Blank Strike' on the nearest enemy.

slots.name: 白夜的決意 (Determination of the White Night)
slots.purpose: Gintoki enters a 'Serious Mode' for 8 seconds. During this time, his movement speed is increased, and every Q and W cast generates a 'Spirit' stack. At 5 stacks, his next Q is a massive 'Final Strike' that deals area damage and knocks back all nearby enemies.

slots.name: 甜點的誘惑 (Sweet Treat Temptation)
slots.purpose: A comedic ultimate. Gintoki pulls out a strawberry milk. For 3 seconds, all nearby enemies are 'Confused' (slowed and slightly pushed back) as they are distracted by the smell. Gintoki gains a massive burst of movement speed.

champion.name: 坂田銀時
champion.description: A samurai who protects the people of Edo with a wooden sword and a lazy attitude. He fights with a mix of high-level swordsmanship and comedic unpredictability.

PASSIVE.name: 木刀的重量
PASSIVE.description: Gain a small shield while stationary. Parrying an attack while shielded deals damage back and resets Q cooldown.

Q.name: 隨意揮砍
Q.description: A horizontal slash. Deals increased damage and range if used while the Passive shield is active.

W.name: 靈魂的奔跑
W.description: Dash forward. If it hits an enemy, you stumble into them, slowing them.

E.name: 反擊：木刀防禦
E.description: Enter a defensive stance. Deflecting an attack triggers an immediate point-blank strike.

R.name: 白夜的決意
R.description: Enter Serious Mode. Gain speed and build stacks. At 5 stacks, the next Q becomes a massive Final Strike.

EX.name: 甜點的誘惑
EX.description: Distract nearby enemies with strawberry milk, slowing them and granting a massive speed boost.
